nurse.text: Welcome to the Bath Sanctuary. We're Georgian, so mind the draught from the sash windows. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: One moment. Relax, there's cucumber water. It's not from the spring. We checked.
All done! They look better than the Royal Crescent. Don't tell the Crescent.
The Ark terminal. It was a Roman hypocaust once. Now it holds creatures. And dust.

else.text: Quite right. Take the waters, take the air, take a bun.
